extra_quotes: Here, we derive a full low-energy effective Hamiltonian for CoO, including orbital exchange terms, using an ab initio force-theorem approach based on DFT+dynamical mean-field theory.

First, the electronic structure of paramagnetic CoO was calculated using DFTTools implementation [77–79] of DFT+DMFT provided by the TRIQS library [80] together with the Wien2k DFT code [81] and the Hubbard-I implementation provided by the MagInt package [82].
